$comment: Capture group (camera.*, widget.*, daily.*, collage.*, notifications.push) — redesign Pass 2 on Retro, 2026-10-16. Surface tokens exist only where Retro measured something specific to the surface (Postcard modal ST-03, recap preview ST-04, Rewind control row RWA/RWB, Glance widget APK/preview art) or where the mechanics reference defines the control (Locket shutter, BeReal dual image, worker composition). Everything else is a global token or a component (design/components.md) named in design/surfaces/*.md. Decisions: design/MERGE_DECISIONS.md 'Redesign — Capture (RC-*)'.

camera.capture.layout.viewfinder.notes: 3:4 is Retro's single-photo container shape (strip tiles 84 × 112, album covers 72 × 97 — retro-visual §3.8) and the camera's native 4:3 photo output (PLATFORM), so the frame is captured as shown. Replaces Yope's full-width 1 : 1.38 viewfinder (MERGE_DECISIONS RC-2). A full-bleed preview (C-35) was rejected: a 3:4 photo filling a 393 × 852 screen shows only 61 % of the captured width (RC-2).
